Andaman and Nicobar.contentHtml:
Cochin Shipyard (CSL) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 04 Senior Project Officer, Project Officer Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official CSL website. The last date to submit the application form is 31-12-2025. In this article, you’ll find the CSL Senior Project Officer, Project Officer Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

Trending Govt Jobs
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • SBI 996 SCO Online Form 2025
  • BSF Constable GD Online Form 2025-26
  • BARC Scientific Officers Online Form 2026
  • SSC 25487 GD Constable Online Form 2025

CSL Senior Project Officer & Project Officer Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL)
Post Name Senior Project Officer & Project Officer (Mechanical, Electrical, Safety)
No of Posts 4
Salary ₹49,100 to ₹71,500 (Consolidated Pay per month plus compensation for extra hours)
Qualification Relevant Engineering Degree/Diploma with minimum 60% marks and specific post-qualification experience
Age Limit Max 35 years (SPO) / Max 30 years (PO) as on 31 Dec 2025
Start Date for Apply  16-12-2025
Last Date for Apply  31-12-2025
Official Website www.cochinshipyard.in

CSL Senior Project Officer & Project Officer Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of posts No of Vacancy
Senior Project Officer (Mechanical) 1
Senior Project Officer (Electrical) 1
Senior Project Officer (Safety) 1
Project Officer (Safety) 1
Total 4

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications for SPO (Mechanical/Electrical): Degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering with minimum 60% marks from a recognized University.
  • Qualifications for SPO (Safety): Degree in Safety Engineering OR Engineering Degree (any branch) OR Degree in Physics/Chemistry OR Diploma in Engineering (any branch).
  • Qualifications for PO (Safety): Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Industrial Safety recognized by State Govt. (requirements may vary based on base degree/diploma).
  • Essential qualifications (Experience):
    • SPO (Mechanical/Electrical): Minimum 4 years post qualification experience in Ship Building/Repair/Marine related/Port/Engineering/Govt/Semi-Govt company.
    • SPO (Safety): 4 years experience for Engineering Degree holders; 7 years experience for other Degree/Diploma holders in safety/production/maintenance department of a Shipyard/Factory handling HSE activities.
    • PO (Safety): 2 years experience for Engineering Degree holders; 5 years experience for other Degree/Diploma holders in safety/production/maintenance department of a Shipyard/Factory handling HSE activities.
  • Desirable: Proficiency and experience of working in a computerized environment (for Mech/Elect SPO). Proficiency in Computer Applications like AutoCAD, SAP, MS Project, MS Office etc. is preferred in general.
  • Experience: Experience acquired after the stipulated qualification date is considered, reckoned as on 31st December 2025. Training with remuneration is treated as experience. Certificates from registered companies/foreign companies are considered.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Project Officer:
    • First Year: ₹63,100/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Second Year: ₹65,200/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Third Year: ₹67,300/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fourth Year: ₹69,400/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fifth Year: ₹71,500/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
  • Project Officer:
    • First Year: ₹49,100/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Second Year: ₹51,200/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Third Year: ₹53,300/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fourth Year: ₹55,400/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fifth Year: ₹57,500/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • For the post of Project Officer, age shall not exceed 30 years as on 31 December 2025.
  • For the post of Senior Project Officer, age shall not exceed 35 years as on 31 December 2025.
  • Age limit after applying all relaxations (Ex-servicemen etc.) shall not exceed 50 years.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of ₹400/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra) should be remitted online.
  • Applicants belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC)/ Scheduled Tribe (ST) are exempted from payment of application fee.

Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 16th December 2025
Last Date of Online Application 31st December 2025
Application Fee Payment Window closes 31st December 2025

Selection Process

  • Selection will be through Power Point Presentation (80 marks for assessing work experience) and Personal Interview (20 marks).
  • Total marks for final selection: 100 marks.
  • CSL reserves the right to hold an objective type test for shortlisting if many applications are received. These test marks will not be used in the final rank list preparation.
  • Certificate verification will be conducted before the Presentation and Interview.
  • Rank lists will be prepared based on aggregate marks in Presentation and Interview, with tie-breaking based on Presentation marks first, then age seniority.

General Information/Instructions

  • The posts are purely temporary on a contract basis for a maximum period of five years.
  • Posting shall be at CSL AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU), Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands/ any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL.
  • The posts are not identified as suitable for Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) due to job requirements (working at heights, confined spaces, etc.).
  • Candidates must meet eligibility requirements before applying. Upload all necessary certificates with the online application.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
  • Call letters will be sent by e-mail/published on the CSL website only.

How To Apply

  • Applicants must visit the website www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page→ CANSRU, Andaman) and follow the User Manual/FAQ.
  • Complete the one-time registration on the SAP Online portal and submit the application against the post from 16 December 2025 to 31 December 2025.
  • Ensure all certificates and a recent passport size colour photograph are uploaded.
  • Ensure the application status shows "In process" after final submission.
  • Retain a soft copy/printout of the online application with the unique registration number for future correspondence.
  • Do not send the application printout/certificates by post.
